evidence: Modifies src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp, src/rpc/txoutproof.cpp, and src/rest.cpp to handle lookups for transactions located in pruned blocks.
rationale: Updates RPC and REST endpoints to return candidate block hashes when querying transactions in pruned blocks, enabling clients to fetch the necessary blocks via getblockfrompeer. Reviewers note an open interface concern regarding whether block hashes should be structured data rather than embedded in error strings.
